info.title: Luma · API
info.description: Local control API. JSON is { ok, data, error }. Select a target, then start. The listen port cannot be changed here.

get.description: Remote panel. A stored access key shows the unlock form first.

post.description: Form field access_key. Sets the luma_lan cookie.

get.description: data is { name: luma, control: true }.
data.session.state is idle, recording, paused, or stopping.

post.description: Starts the target from PUT /target. data is the session snapshot.
Toggles an active recording. Idle stays idle.
Starts saving and returns immediately. Poll GET /session until idle.

get.description: Query kind. Items are { id, title, detail, preview }. Does not select one.
displays, windows, games, cameras, microphones, or mics. games is empty.

put.description: fullscreen, region, window, or audio. Call this before start.

get.description: One host-pixel still. windowIndex returns that window. Saving and copying stay in the browser.
Full settings. lan.accessKey is empty or ***.

patch.description: Writable fields only. lan, lanPort, port, and lanPlayback are rejected.

post.description: Factory settings. Keeps lan and saveFolder.

get.description: Items use id, name, length, duration, date, and isAudio.

post.description: Body startSeconds and endSeconds. Returns { jobId }.

get.description: status is running, done, or error.
